name: Hotta Saaya
source:
Saaya is usually very serious and also a very hard worker. She's respected by her classmates as the class representative due to her good personality. [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url] often teases her for her lack of interest in romance.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
